title: Triple ordinary external-product transposes without a six-functor datum
statement:
Use the finite coefficient field and ring $k,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. All schemes are separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and all maps are separated of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work in the ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ module derived categories on small pro-etale sites, with the canonical pullbacks $Lu^*$, direct images $Ru_*$, adjunctions $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$, derived tensor and signed symmetry $\sigma$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $P\boxtimes Q=L\pi_1^*P\otimes_A^LL\pi_2^*Q$ on a fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product], and insert the canonical pullback, tensor and direct-image composition comparisons.

For maps $u:U\to B$, $v:V\to B$, write $W=U\times_BV$, with projections $r,t$ and $w=ur=vt$. For objects $P,Q$, put $F=Ru_*P$, $G=Rv_*Q$, and define the actual ordinary product
$$\Omega_{u,v}(P,Q)=c_{v,t}^{-1}Rv_*\bigl(\pi_{t,Lr^*P,Q}(\operatorname{Ex}_{*,u,v,P}\otimes1_Q)\bigr)Rv_*(\sigma_{Q,Lv^*F})\pi_{v,Q,F}\sigma_{F,G}.$$
Here $\pi$ and $\operatorname{Ex}_*$ are precisely the counit-defined maps [def-exchange-projection], and $c_{v,t}:Rw_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rv_*Rt_*$ is the canonical compositor [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition]. Its codomain is $Rw_*(P\boxtimes Q)$.
Let $f_i:X_i\to B$ and $M_i\in D(X_{i,\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $i=1,2,3$, be arbitrary. Put $F_i=Rf_{i*}M_i$, $f_{ij}:X_i\times_BX_j\to B$, and $v:X_1\times_BX_2\times_BX_3\to B$, with projections $r_i$ to $X_i$. Define
$$\Theta_L=\Omega_{f_{12},f_3}(M_1\boxtimes M_2,M_3)(\Omega_{f_1,f_2}(M_1,M_2)\otimes1),$$
$$\Theta_R=\Omega_{f_1,f_{23}}(M_1,M_2\boxtimes M_3)(1\otimes\Omega_{f_2,f_3}(M_2,M_3)).$$
After the canonical associators both have source $F_1\otimes F_2\otimes F_3$ and target $Rv_*(Lr_1^*M_1\otimes Lr_2^*M_2\otimes Lr_3^*M_3)$. Their transposes under $Lv^*\dashv Rv_*$ are both the specified map
$$Lv^*(F_1\otimes F_2\otimes F_3)\xrightarrow{\sim}\bigotimes_{i=1}^3 Lr_i^*Lf_i^*F_i\xrightarrow{\bigotimes_{i=1}^3 Lr_i^*\varepsilon_{f_i,M_i}}\bigotimes_{i=1}^3Lr_i^*M_i.$$
Thus $\Theta_L=\Theta_R$. No properness, boundedness, constructibility, invertibility of exchange or projection, compact-support functor, exceptional adjoint or abstract six-functor datum is assumed.

proof.text: For each nested product, transposition commutes with source precomposition, direct-image postcomposition and equality transport. Apply the binary product transpose to the outer product. Naturality of the tensor comparison and pullback compositor moves the inner product into its adjunction transpose. Apply the binary product transpose to that inner product as well. This gives the two nested binary evaluations, with the same source associator and equality transports as the original definitions.
